$comment: The Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * header that used to sit here applied to
every path including /api/*, which made the whole API readable cross-origin
by anything holding a token. It is removed: server.js sets CORS itself, from
PUBLIC_ORIGIN and ADMIN_ORIGIN, so there is one place that decides and it is
the one that knows the deployment's origins.
The rewrite sends /api/* to the Express app; everything else is served as a
static file, and server.js's own fallback picks index.html or admin.html by
path and Host. Both portals therefore run on this one deployment: point
admin.<domain> at it and set ADMIN_ORIGIN, and no other change is needed.

headers.$comment: The staff portal must never be indexed or framed.
